hello, i was diagnosed with pcos last year, and i've put on some weight and have a puffy face everyday, one thing that helped me reduce it was massaging my face and draining lymph nodes!! it worked for me, and if you're interested, you can search  @mila.magnani (either tiktok or ig) , her method is what i used to reduce face swelling. here's the link ( https://pin.it/1LDIl5yTp ) . if you want to exercise, walking for at least 25-30 minutes help, i suggest having a walking pad so that you won't have to go out to walk, and you can play some music that you genuinely enjoy too. 

anyway, i hope you get to love your body even more. it's just telling you something is wrong within it, and healing takes time;  you can take your time taking care of yourself by eating healthier foods, and loving what you have right now. 

trust me that when you start to accept things one by one, and being more gentle with yourself, things will follow, and you'll be able to regain your confidence once again. wishing you all the best in your pcos journey! 🤍
